subject: Pricing proposal: tiered per-token rates + monthly step-up cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@startupx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial tiered pricing proposal + suggested monthly step-up cadence

Hi Alex —

Great to meet yesterday. As promised, attaching a concise proposal for a tiered per-token program that supports a step-up commit over the first three months of your public launch. High level:

- Month 1 (soft launch): 1.5M tokens/month commit, base per-token $0.0009
- Month 2 (scale): 3.0M tokens/month commit, per-token $0.00082
- Month 3+: 5.0M tokens/month commit, per-token $0.00075

We modeled a seasonal buffer to handle spiky usage around marketing pushes and recommend a 10% overage cap with an overage rate 1.25x the committed per-token price.

Attachments: RWI_tiered_pricing_2026Q2.pdf (proposal), SOW_draft_StartupX_v1.docx (work statement, draft)

Can you confirm whether the step-up cadence above aligns with your product launch timeline and whether procurement needs a single consolidated SOW or separate monthly exhibits?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference runtime

From: Alex Chen <alex@startupx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <patricia@startupx.com>
Date: 2026-04-10T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial tiered pricing proposal + suggested monthly step-up cadence

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear breakdown. A few clarifying Qs from our side before we loop procurement: 

1) Can you do a steeper discount on Month 3 given our expected ARR trajectory (we project >$1.2M ARR by month 6)?
2) How flexible is the 10% overage cap — if we exceed the cap for a single month during launch, can that roll into a higher commit for month 4 instead of incurring overage charges?
3) We prefer one master SOW with exhibits per month to keep legal review bounded.

Patricia is on procurement — she will want concrete language around billing cadence, termination rights, and an explicit definition of "committed token" vs "billable token."

Appreciate it —
Alex Chen
Head of Product, StartupX
alex@startupx.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@startupx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-11T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial tiered pricing proposal + suggested monthly step-up cadence

Alex —

Really helpful questions. Quick answers:

1) Steeper Month 3 discount: We can tier Month 3 to $0.00070 per token (volume-dependent) if you commit in writing to the step-up schedule and the 3–6 month roadmap you shared.

2) Overage handling: We can offer a launch exception: if a single launch month exceeds the 10% buffer, we will allow reallocation of those tokens into an increased commit for month 4 (one-time true-up) provided you notify us within 10 business days and the increase doesn't exceed 50% of the prior-month commit. Otherwise standard overage rates apply.

3) Master SOW with monthly exhibits: agreed. We will provide a single SOW with exhibits that enumerate monthly commit and pricing.

I'm looping in Priyom (finance) and Marissa (CS lead) to confirm internal approvals and the specific billing language. Attached: revised RWI_tiered_pricing_2026Q2.pdf (v2 with the optional Month 3 concession).

Next step: Patricia — can your team accept the master SOW + exhibits approach? If yes, Priyom will follow up with precise billing/legal language for procurement review.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachments: RWI_tiered_pricing_2026Q2.pdf

From: Patricia Gomez <patricia@startupx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@startupx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial tiered pricing proposal + suggested monthly step-up cadence

Team —

Thanks — procurement confirms master SOW + monthly exhibits is our preferred approach. A few contractual asks we need redlined before legal engages: 

- Billing cadence: monthly in arrears based on actual billable tokens, with an invoice-level reconciliation when step-up commits are executed.
- Overages: we want a higher overage cap for launch months (25%) with an option to convert overages to committed volume for up to two months (so we can smooth spend if marketing drove spikes).
- Termination: a 60-day notice for convenience termination, but early-exit fees should be limited to the remaining committed token value (not full remaining contract).
- Audit/usage reporting: must include token-level daily usage logs for the prior 90 days via a secure link.

Please provide redlines and whether Redwood can accept the 25% launch cap (we expect 2–3 launch spikes).

Patricia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager, StartupX
patricia@startupx.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia@startupx.com>, Alex Chen <alex@startupx.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial tiered pricing proposal + suggested monthly step-up cadence

Hi Patricia / Alex —

Thanks for the clear asks. From Finance's perspective we can accommodate most of this with the following guardrails: 

- Billing cadence: monthly in arrears with an invoice reconciliation window of 30 days. We will include a line-item reconciliation for any post-invoice commit adjustments.
- Launch overage cap: we can increase the launch month buffer to 25% for up to two launch months (not three), provided StartupX commits in writing to the step-up schedule (Month 1 -> Month 2 -> Month 3 commits).
- Conversion option: We will permit conversion of launch-month overages into committed volume for up to two subsequent months; any conversion must be requested within 7 business days of invoice.
- Termination fees: we will cap early-exit exposure to pro-rated committed token value for the remaining contract term (subject to an 8-week notice).
- Audit/usage reporting: daily token-level logs will be available via a secure S3 link with 90-day retention; we'll include a sample CSV format in the SOW.

If that sounds acceptable, we'll produce a redline of the SOW and the billing exhibit and circulate for signature.

- Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

From: Alex Chen <alex@startupx.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Gomez <patricia@startupx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-13T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial tiered pricing proposal + suggested monthly step-up cadence

Thanks all — that aligns with what we need. Two quick items before we finalize: 

1) Please include an explicit definition for "token" in the SOW (we use different tokenization across internal pipelines).
2) Can you provide a DocuSign link once the SOW is redlined so we can get legal/procurement to e-sign quickly?

If you can get the redline + DocuSign ready today or tomorrow, we can aim for signature by end of week and kick off the soft launch on May 4.

Appreciate the responsiveness —
Alex
